data.name: Alamguir
data.gender_notes: Alamguir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'alamah' meaning 'to inform' or 'to warn'. Alamguir refers to a mighty warrior who protects and guards against danger, providing guidance and wisdom. This name reflects the courage and strength of a righteous leader in Islam. The name Alamguir carries the meaning “Exalted protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alamguir usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Alamguir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alamguir total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

Alamgir refers to a place where a person resides, settles, and finds stability. It is a source of comfort and stability. In Islamic tradition, Alamgir is associated with the concept of patience and perseverance. It is a reminder to Muslims to remain steadfast in the face of adversity and to seek guidance from Allah.

data.cultural_impact: The name Alamguir holds a deep cultural significance as it is rooted in early Islamic history. Alamguir was the name of a great Muslim hero, Alamgir II, who ruled from 1658 to 1666 CE. He was a powerful ruler and military commander who expanded the Mughal Empire in India. During his reign, he captured the major fortresses of Jaipur, Amber, and Bikaner, paving the way for the Mughal influence in North India. Alamguir's name was an embodiment of his prowess and ability to protect and expand the territory under his rule. This name continues to inspire Muslims and non-Muslims alike, as a symbol of courage, strength, and leadership.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, Alamguir symbolizes the guardian of faith. The name represents the fearless warrior in the battlefield of life, who fights against evil and upholds truth and justice. The 'alamah' in Alamguir suggests the idea of a constant reminder, guiding us to the path of righteousness and warning us against the perils of temptation and sin. This name embodies the idea of being a beacon of truth and light for others, leading them towards the blessings of God. Ultimately, Alamguir serves as a reminder of the importance of staying steadfast in faith, living a truthful and virtuous life, and standing up for justice and righteousness.
